intended_object: A predicate used inside the proof of Nöbeling's theorem (Scholze, Condensed Mathematics, Thm 5.4). A product e_{i_r}⋯e_{i_1} is "good" when it is not in the ℤ-span of products that are lexicographically smaller. Inferred from the docstring and the module documentation.
explanation: This definition lives in the `Profinite.NobelingProof` namespace and is a device built only for the proof. It is used to pick out a candidate basis of `LocallyConstant C ℤ` for the ordinal induction. It has no standard counterpart in the literature beyond the proof it serves. For what it is worth, it matches the proof's description: `l.eval C` does not lie in the ℤ-span of the evaluations of the products `m < l`.
